title: Anisotropic information geometry of entropy production
summary: We reveal that the information geometry of entropy production exhibits an intrinsic anisotropy, providing a unified origin for the inequivalent geometric constraints obeyed by its different components. Using a hierarchical projection structure of quantum relative entropy, we derive an exact orthogonal decomposition of entropy production into three distinct geometric contributions associated with the deviation of the Gibbs projection temperature from the reference temperature, the deviation of the environment from its Gibbs projection state, and system--environment correlations.
